subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is 'Plentiful'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Abundant is an adjective that means existing or available in large quantities.
 
• The meaning of the given options is as follows - 
 
 
• Abysmal - extremely bad; appalling.
 
• Ephemeral - lasting for a very short time.
 
• Scarce - (especially of food, money, or some other resource) insufficient for the demand.
 
• Plentiful - existing in or yielding great quantities.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that plentiful is the correct synonym for the word abundant.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
